title: [GMCP 203.012.02] Production path: Subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messages
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-012-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Modern subscriptions/listen filters and acknowledgement metadata work for tools, prompts, resources and resource updates, with bounded fan-out, ordering guarantees, cancellation, reconnect policy, backpressure and authorization re-checks. Progress and operational log notifications correlate to the originating request, obey requested levels and redaction, and never become an unbounded covert channel. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Production stage (GMCP-203-012-02) implements and verifies all subscription filter/cap/lag/re-check invariants, progress token validation/uniqueness/monotonicity/cancellation guards, request-correlated RFC 5424 operational logging with stream isolation/cap/redaction/size-bounds, SEP-2577 legacy/modern gating, and Streamable HTTP SSE routing across stdio, embedded adapter, and live HTTP /mcp; full cross-vector integration, adversarial fuzz/exhaustion, interop benchmark, and operations runbook suites remain in T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-95..98.

Named VC-203-012 evidence (.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-012.jsonl) and mastery verdict (.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-012.json) are created and sealed by T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-99 once requirements 01-06 land; existing retained VC-203-*.jsonl evidence records are updated via Two-Phase Evidence against this commit.

reuse.reason: Reuses shipped MCP protocol types (crate::mcp::{model,message,service,http}), GmcpService and Catalog/ResourceGuard/Changes broadcast in crate::protocol, untrusted sink redaction (susi_core::untrusted_content::wrap_tool_output + susi_config credential redaction), TaskManager lifecycle cancellation, and existing StdioSession / AdapterClient / start_http_server test harnesses in tests/gmcp_requirements.rs without introducing duplicate notification routers or new dependencies.
